Hildegard 0.1.18 is a pre-alpha. **Hildegard is now a plugin in [Local Studio](https://github.com/baney75/local-studio).**
The app keeps working, with your projects, voices and models, but new features go into the plugin.
[How to switch](https://github.com/baney75/hildegard/blob/main/docs/local-studio.md#moving-from-the-hildegard-app).

## Install

- **macOS and Linux:** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh`
- **Server (the engine as a service, for Local Studio and your other devices):** `curl -fsSL https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.sh | sh -s -- --server`
- **Windows (PowerShell):** `irm https://dbaney.com/hildegard/install.ps1 | iex`
- **Local Studio:** install Hildegard from **Settings › Plugins**, or `local-studio plugin install hildegard`.

Installed already? Hildegard updates itself, or run `hildegard update` (or `hildegard update all` for every device).

## New

- **The Local Studio plugin.** Seventeen commands: `/image`, `/video`, `/speak`, `/design-voice`, `/clean-audio` and
  `/hildegard` make media through `hildegard make`, which waits, saves, reviews and never clones a voice. `/film`,
  `/art`, `/sound`, `/photo`, `/edit-video`, `/3d`, `/web`, `/loop`, `/design`, `/music` and `/motion` are the craft
  skills. `hildegard mcp --skills` serves the plugin's own skills to its tools. Printing goes through Gantrel.
- **Images.** Make and edit images in the Studio, over the API and MCP, with Z-Image Turbo, Qwen-Image and
  Qwen-Image-Edit. Every stills file is pinned.
- **Record from anywhere.** Record a voice-over from any chat, cleaned. A phone records over a private link on one yes.
- **Craft skills any model can follow:** motion graphics drawn in code, music and sound effects from recipes,
  tested photo editing, design and blog skills, and a writer's own voice. Each skill also works on its own.
- **Prose lint** for machine-made tells, measured so it doesn't fail ordinary human writing.
- **Tunnels on an account you own:** `hildegard tunnel` with Tailscale or Cloudflare.
- **The Studio:** searchable Settings with Appearance and Keyboard shortcuts, a one-screen first run, takes that fill
  the board, and a composer that never covers the work.
- **Pairing** without anyone seeing the code: `choir invite --code-only` piped to `join`.

## Fixed

- Voice-over stays in sync on long films, and recordings keep their offset.
- `--help` never runs a command, and `pnpm dev` and the tests stay off an installed Hildegard.
- Pairing reads the join's whole answer.
